title: Buddha-Like
synopsis: Young people in China are becoming more “Buddha-like”, but is this a good or a bad thing?

fullText.simplified:
佛系

    佛系青年、佛系员工、佛系乘客、佛系买家、佛系恋爱……一大波“佛系”概念汹涌来袭。
    “佛系”是一个流行词，这个词最早来源于2014年日本的某杂志，该杂志介绍了“佛系男子”，认为“佛系男子”是指专注于自己的兴趣或工作，不愿花时间与异性交往的男子。后来，约在2018年，“佛系”这个词开始频繁地在中文网络和媒体上出现，在中文的语境里，“佛系”大概意思是：有也行，没有也行，看淡一切，不争不抢，不求输赢，无欲无求的一种生活态度。
    比如“佛系员工”就是指“说我好也行，说我不好也行”的员工：被老板骂了，会说“哦，知道了”；被老板表扬了，也只会说“哦，谢谢”，工作质量永远保证合格，但从来不会有惊喜。“佛系买家”就是指“买的东西好也行，不好也行”的买家：在网上购物时，不差评，不和卖家较劲，不和快递较劲，对购买的东西保持很淡定的心态，即使东西不好也不急躁，大不了扔了以后不在这家买就是了。“佛系恋爱”就是指“在一起也行，分手也行”的恋爱态度：两个人在一起待着舒服就凑合着过了，被伤害了也懒得一哭二闹三上吊。分手之后一般会说声拜拜然后大步走开，不会纠缠不休。
    在中国，越来越多的90后称自己为“佛系青年”。对于这种“佛系生活”，社会上褒贬不一。有人认为这样云淡风轻的生活态度很好，也有人认为这样处处不走心，处处不坚持，事事随大流的生活态度会让人淹没于人潮、迷失掉自我。
fullText.traditional:
佛系

    佛系青年、佛系員工、佛系乘客、佛系買家、佛系戀愛……一大波“佛系”概念洶湧來襲。
    “佛系”是一個流行詞，這個詞最早來源於2014年日本的某雜誌，該雜誌介紹了“佛系男子”，認為“佛系男子”是指專注於自己的興趣或工作，不願花時間與異性交往的男子。後來，約在2018年，“佛系”這個詞開始頻繁地在中文網絡和媒體上出現，在中文的語境裡，“佛系”大概意思是：有也行，沒有也行，看淡一切，不爭不搶，不求輸贏，無欲無求的一種生活態度。
    比如“佛系員工”就是指“說我好也行，說我不好也行”的員工：被老闆罵了，會說“哦，知道了”；被老闆表揚了，也只會說“哦，謝謝”，工作質量永遠保證合格，但從來不會有驚喜。“佛系買家”就是指“買的東西好也行，不好也行”的買家：在網上購物時，不差評，不和賣家較勁，不和快遞較勁，對購買的東西保持很淡定的心態，即使東西不好也不急躁，大不了扔了以後不在這家買就是了。“佛系戀愛”就是指“在一起也行，分手也行”的戀愛態度：兩個人在一起待著舒服就湊合著過了，被傷害了也懶得一哭二鬧三上吊。分手之後一般會說聲拜拜然後大步走開，不會糾纏不休。
    在中國，越來越多的90後稱自己為“佛系青年”。對於這種“佛系生活”，社會上褒貶不一。有人認為這樣雲淡風輕的生活態度很好，也有人認為這樣處處不走心，處處不堅持，事事隨大流的生活態度會讓人淹沒於人潮、迷失掉自我。

sentences.english: Even if they buy something bad, they will not be annoyed.

sentences.simplified: 分手之后一般会说声拜拜然后大步走开，不会纠缠不休。

After breaking up they will say goodbye and then quickly walk away, and will not hassle endlessly.

sentences.english: Towards this “Buddha-like life” there are mixed opinions in society.

sentences.english: Others believe that this way of being indifferent towards everything and not persistent with anything, ..
.. having a follow-the–crowd type of life attitude, will make people drown in the crowd and lose themselves.

raw.synopsis: Young people in China are becoming more “Buddha-like”, but is this a good or a bad thing?
sentence_translations: Buddha-Like
Buddha-like youngsters, Buddha-like workers, Buddha-like passengers, Buddha-like buyers, Buddha-like dating…
A big wave of “Buddha-like” notions is surging and battering.
“Buddha-like” is a buzzword which first appeared in a Japanese magazine in 2014.
This magazine described “Buddha-like men”, referring to men who only care about their own hobbies or work, ..
.. and are unwilling to spend time dating the opposite sex.
Later, at around 2018, the word “Buddha-like” started to frequently appear in Chinese media and online sites.
In the context of Chinese, “Buddha-like” roughly means:
Ok with having or not having, indifferent towards everything, does not argue or debate, ..
.. does not care about winning, free of desires and demands type of attitude towards life.
For example, a “Buddha-like worker” is “fine with being praised or reprimanded”:
If they are reprimanded by their boss, they will say “Oh, ok.”
If they are praised by their boss, they will also just say: “Oh, thanks.”
The quality of their work is always passable, but never surprises.
“Buddha-like buyer” is a buyer that is fine with “buying things that are good, or things that are not good”:
When they shop online, they will not leave bad reviews or argue with the seller or the delivery company.
They have a calm attitude towards the things they buy.
Even if they buy something bad, they will not be annoyed.
If worst comes to worst, they will just not buy from that seller again after throwing the item away.
“Buddha-like dating” is dating with the attitude “fine with being together, and fine with breaking up”:
If two people feel comfortable together, then they will adequately spend time together.
If they end up getting hurt, they won’t bother making a fuss.
After breaking up they will say goodbye and then quickly walk away, and will not hassle endlessly.
In China, more and more people born in the 1990s call themselves “Buddha-like youngsters”.
Towards this “Buddha-like life” there are mixed opinions in society.
Some believe that this type of clear skies life attitude is good.
Others believe that this way of being indifferent towards everything and not persistent with anything, ..
.. having a follow-the–crowd type of life attitude, will make people drown in the crowd and lose themselves.
